_comment: Caretaker Config — Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3 fields
_comment_compression:
──── Phase 2 — Compression ────
Set compression_model to 'local' for free spaCy+TextRank.
Set to 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' for paid Haiku API.
_comment_cloud:
──── Phase 3 — Cloud sync (Supabase) ────
Leave supabase_url and supabase_key empty to disable cloud sync.
Leave encrypt_key empty to disable encryption (NOT recommended).
Get these from https://supabase.com → project settings → API.
_comment_scheduler:
──── Phase 3 — Nightly maintenance scheduler ────
maintenance_time: HH:MM in UTC (default 02:00 = 2am UTC)
scheduler_enabled: set false to disable APScheduler (manual only)
_comment_multiagent:
──── Phase 3 — Multi-agent settings ────
default_agent_id: used when agent does not pass agent_id
known_agents: list for stats and logging only (not enforced)
_comment_dedup:
──── Phase 3 — Deduplication settings ────
dedup_keyword_overlap_threshold: Jaccard overlap above which two memories are considered duplicates (0.0–1.0)
_comment_boost:
──── Phase 3 — Importance boost settings ────
boost_min_retrievals: min retrieval_count before boost applies
boost_per_retrieval: importance increase per extra retrieval
boost_max: absolute max boost applied in one nightly run
_comment_database:
──── Database paths ────
Update chromadb_path to your absolute local path.
